technique_name: Cook a vegan meal using the items in the following list.
description: Vegan Roasted Potatoes with Broccoli: Preheat the oven to 400°F. Wash and cut the potatoes into small cubes. Place the potatoes in a large bowl and add in two tablespoons of olive oil. Gently mix the potatoes with the oil, making sure that all the cubes are evenly covered with oil. Place the potatoes on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Peel and mince the garlic, then sprinkle it over the potatoes. Place the potatoes in the oven and bake for about 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Mean
example: Ingredient list: olive oil, potatoes, broccoli, garlic, parsley
